snippet.title: Scientific project: Optic - Trailer
snippet.description:
The free demo for Scientific Project: Optic is OUT NOW!

🎮 PLAY NOW: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4568930/Scientific_project_Optic_Demo/
✨ Add to Wishlist: https://store.steampowered.com/app/752290/Scientific_project_Optic/

Scientific Project: Optic is an atmospheric first-person puzzle game that guides you through the history of optical science. Embark on a journey from philosophical origins in Antiquity to our modern understanding of complex phenomena.

Master the laws of geometric optics, manipulate reflections, and solve puzzles inspired by real scientific discoveries. No hand-holding, just you, the nature of light, and the environment.

Key Features:
• Realistic Physics: Use mirrors, lenses, and prisms to manipulate light rays.
• Authentic Atmosphere: Explore historical settings, starting from ancient temples.
• Independent Discovery: Solve spatial puzzles strictly governed by real-world physics.

Developed by KHVOYA Games | Published by COR-Software.

#ScientificProjectOptic #PuzzleGame #IndieGame #FirstPersonPuzzle #SteamGames #GameDev #Optics
